title: Pill Crusher, Mini Marble and Pestle Set, Pill Crusher Grinder Fine Powder, Arthritic Hands Pill Grinder
description:
About this item
【The easy way】The idea of the mortar and pestle goes back a long, long time and continues to this day. Pills are gently crushed and ground into a fine powder
【NO RESIDUE: The inside of the marble pill crusher is hand polished to a very smooth finish, and you can easily remove all the powder with the included small brush
【PROTECT YOUR WRIST】Usual plastic rotary grinders require the wrist to rotate very hard, which is not good for arthritis patients. Marble Pill Grinder.
【EASY TO CLEAN】The inside and outside of the mortar have been sanded and polished to a very smooth finish, just rinse with water and it looks brand new
【Package】1x pill grinder，1 x pill organizer , 1 x pill cutter, 1 x small brush
reviews_5s:
I was surprised that they included gifts I wasn't expecting. A razor type pill divider/splitter and a week pill box!, along with a small brush to clear out the pill crusher, all were a good surprise. I will use the pill crusher for pet meds to put in their food, but the rest I will use myself.Perfect. This works well and is a great price for all items included.Bought this to crush up my dogs joint supplements as she doesn't like the chewy treats one so i have to buy the tablets and they are huge. This works perfectly for that and it's nice and small (but super durable) so I can store on my counter. Exactly what I was looking for it. Use it everyday.While the set was physically smaller than I expected, it is PERFECT for crushing pills. This easily grinds the pills and is very easy to clean (brush was included). It is the rough surface in the mortar that make it work so well.
If you need to grind up pills, this is the tool to buy. I absolutely recommend it.I originally ordered this for our older dog as he hates taking his meds. I can crush the pills and sprinkle it on his food without problems. I should add that we had tried just about everything else so this was a last resort for us. Even Pill Pickets would not work with him. I feel like it would work well for crushing dried herbs as well.This little magic pill crusher saved my day!! Only one I can actually crush to powder. Already bought a second one!!I was impressed that this also came with a brush, pill planner, and pill cutter. This works really well and grinds pills down to dust. It is sturdy, great quality, a perfect weight, and easy to use.Great size to crush up pills for our pug, so glad we found the smaller size. Bonus it is heavy, and really pretty.The size of this Mortar that works really well. I recently used this to grind up some Vitamin C tablets that I preferred to mix with my vitamin water and this tool worked great. I purchased a larger Mortar to handle the size of the vitamin tablets I had at the time. The Mortar was easy to clean once I was done and packed right back into the box to keep it nice if I have to use it again. Great tool.Just right size for small pills. Nice little item. Works very well.
